scenes.audio: Here are all the animations for the upcoming universal heirloom in season 26. Thanks EA for the invite to the preview event. I will also include all the pull out and twirling animations while sprinting.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: View from eyes of a tall android character with metallic red/gold plating and black claw-like fingertips. Hands hold a red baseball bat with a white net pattern. Background is an outdoor desert training facility with concrete platforms and targets. Bright natural lighting with blue skies. Saturated color palette.

scenes.audio: The deathbox, the recolors, and everything else you can think of.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A white and gold mechanical crate with rainbow stripes floats and rotates against a dark hexagonal background. Studio lighting highlights metallic textures. Sharp focus on the container's gold central lens.

scenes.audio: Mechanical clicks and whirring followed by the roaring sound of jet flames.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The character triggers a button on the white/blue/red bat. The handle expands, revealing glowing internal components and venting orange fire from side ports. Handheld camera movement during the action. Background remains the sunny firing range.

scenes.audio: Rapid metallic sliding sounds and intense fire whooshing.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Character performs a complex inspection; the bat flips rapidly while emitting fire from the tip. Parts shift and slide in a high-tech manner. Character's red metallic claws grip the handle firmly. Bright daylight highlights the white paint of the bat.

scenes.audio: Heavy mechanical latches unlocking and the sound of a pressurized can opening.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The bat splits open down the middle. Character reaches in and pulls out a blue beverage can labeled 'JUICE'. The bat's interior shows gold lining and wiring. Warm sunlight reflects off the can's surface.

scenes.audio: Metallic clanking as the bat closes, followed by a sustained fire roar and energy hum.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Character tosses the can and reassembles the bat. It begins spinning at high speed, creating a circle of fire in front of the character. Handheld camera shakes with the intensity of the flames.

scenes.audio: Subtle sliding of metal on gloves and rhythmic mechanical ticking.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Character rotates the white bat horizontally, examining the 'SLAM' text. Fingers trace the grip. The handle end shows a red 'R5' logo. Soft shadows fall across the desert ground in the background.

scenes.audio: Quiet metallic clinking and soft footsteps on sand.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Character lowers their perspective as if crouching. The bat is held across the chest. Camera moves with a slight sway to simulate walking while low. Bright sun creates hard shadows on the concrete floor.

scenes.audio: Light plastic flicking sounds and a faint electronic chime.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: While crouching, the character pulls out a red collectible card showing an illustration of another character. The card is held up to the camera, then flipped. Hands are close-up, showing detailed gold mechanical joints.

scenes.audio: Soft card shuffling sounds and a heavy metallic thud as the bat is gripped.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Character continues looking at the card, flipping it to reveal different artwork. The card is put away and the bat is brought back into frame. Depth of field blurs the targets in the distance.

scenes.audio: Sharp metallic click and the sound of air displacement.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Character quickly equips the bat from a holstered position. It performs a quick spin and a mechanical 'click' as it locks into the character's hand. High-speed action with motion blur.

scenes.audio: Heavy thuds on impact, metallic ringing, and the sound of wood/metal striking plastic.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Character swings the red bat at purple training dummies. Each hit produces a red impact effect and sparks. Camera tracks the swinging motion. Background is the open-air firing range.

scenes.audio: Low-pitched swooshes and dull impacts.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Character performs low horizontal swings while crouching. The bat cuts through the air quickly. Camera tilts down toward the training dummy's legs.

scenes.audio: Louder, explosive impact sound and heavy landing noise.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Character jumps and slams the bat down onto a dummy. Red shockwave effects appear on the ground. Background shows industrial buildings and mountains.

scenes.audio: Fast-paced metallic clicking and the sound of heavy robotic breathing.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Character runs forward while spinning the white bat in their hand. The bat twirls continuously. The camera bobbles rhythmically to simulate a sprinting pace. Training equipment passes by quickly.

scenes.audio: Consistent rhythmic mechanical deployment sounds.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Standing still, the character puts the bat away and pulls it back out multiple times. Each time it performs a different flourishing spin. Sunlight glints off the white polished surface.

scenes.audio: Whistling air sound followed by a solid catch thud.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A rare holster animation: the character tosses the bat high into the air and catches it behind their back. Rapid camera tilt upwards following the object's arc.

scenes.audio: Rapid footsteps on concrete and mechanical whirring.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: While running, the character holsters the bat and draws it back out. The camera is very shaky. The character's red claws are visible on the edge of the frame.

scenes.audio: Repetitive metallic clicks and clacks over a fast tempo wind noise.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Character continues running through the facility, repeating the holster/draw cycle. Diverse props like ammo boxes and weapon racks are visible in the background.

scenes.audio: Up-tempo electronic music starts. A chaotic mix of hit sounds, fire roars, and mechanical clicks.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Fast-cut montage showing a mix of attacks, sprints, and inspections. The camera moves aggressively with every action. Sparks and fire effects frequent the screen.

scenes.audio: Climax of the music with heavy bass beats synced to the on-screen swings.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Montage concludes with the character spinning the bat and sliding across the floor. Background shifts through different areas of the firing range facility.

scenes.audio: Low-frequency hum and small mechanical servos whirring.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Detailed look at the 'Deathbox' from scene 2. It is white with a gold front panel, rainbow stripes, and a small screen showing 'DBX-01'. It rotates 360 degrees in front of a dark, tech-themed wall.

scenes.audio: Gentle mechanical clicking as the bat is turned.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Showcasing the red 'Recolor' version of the bat. It has a net pattern on the barrel and a digital screen on the handle base showing '2019'. Character rotates it slowly.

scenes.audio: Soft metallic rustling and a faint energy pulse sound.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Showcasing the green 'Recolor' version with purple and yellow accents. The barrel features 'BOOM' text in a comic-book style font. The end cap logo is purple.

scenes.audio: Final mechanical click and the music fades out.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Showcasing the final 'Recolor' with a white base and blue/red polka dots. The screen on the base says '35 PRO'. Background is the sun-drenched training grounds.
